name: get_workspace
description: Workspace details, settings and your role.

name: update_workspace
description: Rename the workspace or change its slug (admin).

name: create_label
description: Add a custom workspace label (admin). Templates Bug, Feature, Improvement and Documentation already exist. Returns the workspace.

name: update_label
description: Rename or recolor a workspace label (admin). Templates can be recolored but not renamed.

params.name: body string New name (custom labels only)

name: delete_label
description: Delete a custom workspace label and remove it from issues, projects, repositories and workstreams (admin). Templates cannot be deleted.

name: get_snapshot
description: Everything in the workspace in one (large) payload: users, teams, workstreams, issues, decisions, artifacts, events, attention, views. Prefer targeted list_* tools; only usable by user-acting tokens.

name: search
description: Full-text search across workstreams, projects, issues, decisions, artifacts, repositories and teams.

name: list_events
description: Activity log of every change, newest first.

params.workstreamId: query string Only events of this workstream
params.subject: query string '<type>:<id>', e.g. issue:iss_abc
params.type: query string Event type or prefix, e.g. 'issue.'
params.before: query string ISO timestamp: only older events

name: get_graph
description: Dependency/ownership graph of workstreams, artifacts, actors and repositories.

params.teamId: query string Restrict to a team
params.workstreamId: query string Restrict to a workstream

name: list_members
description: Workspace members with their user profile and role.

name: add_member
description: Add an existing user to the workspace by email (admin).

name: change_member_role
description: Change a member's role (admin). id = membership id.

name: remove_member
description: Remove a member (admin). id = membership id.

name: list_agents
description: AI agents registered in the workspace.

name: get_agent
description: One agent.

name: create_agent
description: Register an AI agent (admin).

name: update_agent
description: Update an agent (admin).

name: delete_agent
description: Delete an agent and revoke its tokens (admin).

name: list_tokens
description: API tokens (never their secrets). Admins see all, others their own.

name: revoke_token
description: Revoke an API token.

name: list_integrations
description: Git provider integrations (admin).

name: get_integration
description: One integration.

name: list_outgoing_webhooks
description: Outgoing webhooks (admin).

name: get_outgoing_webhook
description: One outgoing webhook.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
description: Recent deliveries of an outgoing webhook.

name: list_teams
description: All teams.

name: get_team
description: One team.

params.idOrKey: path string! Team id or key (e.g. AUTH)

name: create_team
description: Create a team (admin). The key is immutable.

params.name: body string! Name
params.key: body string! 2-8 uppercase letters/digits, starts with a letter (e.g. AUTH)
params.leadIds: body string[] Lead user ids (subset of memberIds)
params.editPolicy: body string(workspace|members) Who may edit its work

name: update_team
description: Update a team (admin).

params.idOrKey: path string! Team id or key (e.g. AUTH)
params.name: body string Name

name: delete_team
description: Delete a team (409 while it owns workstreams).

params.idOrKey: path string! Team id or key (e.g. AUTH)

name: list_repositories
description: Linked git repositories.

name: get_repository
description: One repository.

name: create_repository
description: Register a repository.

name: update_repository
description: Update a repository.

name: delete_repository
description: Remove a repository.

name: list_workstreams
description: List workstreams (the units of work an AI/human team ships).

params.teamId: query string Owner or participating team
params.label: query string Label

name: get_workstream
description: One workstream with criteria and status.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: get_workstream_context
description: Markdown briefing for a workstream: objective, criteria, decisions, dependencies, artifacts, open questions, recent progress.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: get_workstream_graph
description: Graph around one workstream.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: create_workstream
description: Create a workstream. Key = <ownerTeamKey>-<n>.

params.title: body string! Title
params.deltaThreadUrl: body string https URL on delta.dev (the Delta thread carrying this workstream). Optional: a workstream can exist before its thread; omit it rather than invent one. A supplied URL is validated
params.projectId: body string Project id. The workstream then works in the project's repositories (inherited when repositoryIds is omitted)

name: update_workstream
description: Partially update a workstream; null clears optional fields.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)
params.title: body string Title
params.deltaThreadUrl: body string https URL on delta.dev (the Delta thread carrying this workstream)
params.projectId: body string Project id (null detaches). repositoryIds must be a subset of the project's

name: delete_workstream
description: Delete a workstream and everything attached to it.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: add_criterion
description: Add an acceptance criterion.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: update_criterion
description: Update an acceptance criterion.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: remove_criterion
description: Remove an acceptance criterion.

params.idOrKey: path string! Workstream id or key (e.g. AUTH-42)

name: list_projects
description: Projects: planned outcomes (Linear-style) that workstreams carry out. Each project carries customerCount (distinct customers who asked for it).

params.customerId: query string Only projects this customer asked for
params.tierId: query string Only projects a customer of this tier asked for (workspace.settings.customerTiers id)
params.minCustomers: query integer At least this many distinct requesting customers
params.minRequests: query integer At least this many customer requests
params.minRevenue: query integer The requesting customers' annual revenue adds up to at least this (each customer counted once)
params.important: query boolean true = only projects with at least one request flagged important

name: get_project
description: One project.

name: create_project
description: Create a project (a planned outcome). Workstreams carry it out; milestones belong to it.

params.name: body string! Name
params.repositoryIds: body string[] Repository ids (where the work happens)

name: update_project
description: Partially update a project; null clears optional fields. Removing a repository also removes it from the project's workstreams.

params.name: body string Name
params.icon: body string Lucide icon name (kebab-case, e.g. rocket) or one emoji (null clears)
params.leadId: body string Lead user id (null clears)

name: delete_project
description: Delete a project and its milestones. Its workstreams are kept, detached.

name: get_project_context
description: Markdown briefing for a whole project (mega context): overview, latest updates, milestones, workstreams, issues, artifacts, decisions, open questions. Read it before working on a project.

name: list_project_updates
description: Status updates posted on a project (health + markdown write-up), newest first.

name: get_project_update
description: One project update.

name: create_project_update
description: Post a status update on a project. The newest update sets the project's health. Report facts, not guesses.

params.body: body string! Markdown write-up: what shipped, what is next, risks

name: update_project_update
description: Edit the health or body of a project update.

name: delete_project_update
description: Delete a project update; the project's health falls back to the previous update.

name: list_project_artifacts
description: Artifacts attached to the project itself, plus those of its workstreams and issues.

name: list_milestones
description: Milestones of projects, ordered.

name: get_milestone
description: One milestone.

name: create_milestone
description: Create a milestone in a project.

name: update_milestone
description: Update a milestone.

name: reorder_milestones
description: Set the order of a project's milestones.

params.ids: body string[]! Milestone ids in the new order

name: delete_milestone
description: Delete a milestone.

name: list_input_requests
description: Questions agents/people asked humans.

name: get_input_request
description: One input request.

name: create_input_request
description: Ask a human a question on a workstream.

name: update_input_request
description: Edit an open input request.

name: answer_input_request
description: Answer an open input request.

name: dismiss_input_request
description: Dismiss an open input request.

name: delete_input_request
description: Delete an input request.

name: list_issues
description: List issues (bugs, features, incidents, debt, feedback, ideas, security). Sort out demand with customerId, minCustomers, minRequests, tierId, minRevenue and important.

params.open: query boolean true = only issues still in play (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review)
params.limit: query integer Newest first, at most this many (1-500)
params.customerId: query string Only issues linked to this customer
params.minCustomers: query integer At least this many distinct linked customers
params.minRequests: query integer At least this many customer requests
params.tierId: query string Only issues a customer of this tier asked for (workspace.settings.customerTiers id)
params.minRevenue: query integer The requesting customers' annual revenue adds up to at least this (each customer counted once)
params.important: query boolean true = only issues with at least one request flagged important

name: get_issue
description: One issue (old keys still resolve).

params.idOrKey: path string! Issue id or key (e.g. BUG-142)

name: create_issue
description: Create an issue; status defaults to backlog. Subject to per-token write caps.

name: update_issue
description: Partially update an issue. Changing kind re-keys it; duplicateOfId marks it a duplicate; null clears optional fields.

params.idOrKey: path string! Issue id or key (e.g. BUG-142)
params.title: body string Title
params.projectId: body string Project id (null clears; drops that project's milestone)
params.milestoneIds: body string[] Milestone ids (max one per project; from the issue's project or its workstreams' projects)
params.duplicateOfId: body string Id or key of the original (null clears)

name: link_issue
description: Attach an issue to existing workstreams and/or a new one created atomically. Linking is organizational and does not change the issue status; pass status only to change it deliberately (moving to in_progress is a separate action).

params.idOrKey: path string! Issue id or key (e.g. BUG-142)
params.createWorkstream: body object New workstream {title, ownerTeamId, deltaThreadUrl?, objective?, ...}
params.status: body string(draft|backlog|todo|in_progress|in_review|done|canceled) Optional explicit status. Omit to keep the current one

name: delete_issue
description: Delete an issue.

params.idOrKey: path string! Issue id or key (e.g. BUG-142)

name: list_customers
description: Companies that asked for things (customers), with domains, logo, revenue, size, tier and status. Archived customers are hidden unless archived=true or archived=all.

params.archived: query string(true|false|all) true = only archived, all = both, otherwise active
params.issueId: query string Only customers with a request on this issue
params.projectId: query string Only customers with a request on this project
params.tierId: query string Only customers of this tier (workspace.settings.customerTiers id)
params.q: query string Name or any domain

name: get_customer
description: One customer (company), archived or not.

name: create_customer
description: Create a customer (a company). Domains are normalized (lower-case, no scheme or www), the first is the primary, and none may belong to another customer of the workspace (409). Send domains or domain. tierId must be a tier from get_workspace settings.customerTiers.

params.name: body string! Customer name
params.domains: body string[] Domains, primary first (1-20), e.g. ["acme.com","acme.io"]
params.domain: body string Single domain; use domains for several
params.logoUrl: body string http(s) URL of the logo
params.revenue: body integer Annual revenue, whole number >= 0 (workspace currency)
params.size: body integer Company size in people, whole number >= 0

name: update_customer
description: Edit a customer: name, domains (replaces the list), domain (replaces only the primary), logoUrl, revenue, size, tierId, status, or archive/restore it. null clears logoUrl, revenue, size and tierId. Archiving keeps requests and issues.

params.name: body string Name
params.domains: body string[] Replaces all domains, primary first (1-20)
params.domain: body string Replaces the primary domain, keeps the others
params.logoUrl: body string http(s) logo URL, null clears
params.revenue: body integer Annual revenue >= 0, null clears
params.size: body integer Company size >= 0, null clears
params.tierId: body string Customer tier id, null clears
params.archived: body boolean true archives, false restores

name: delete_customer
description: Delete a customer and its requests. Issues and projects are kept.

name: list_customer_requests
description: Requests of one customer, newest first, in full (markdown body, important, sourceUrl), each with its issue (key, title, status) or project (name, status).

name: create_customer_request
description: Record what a customer asked for, on exactly one issue (issueId) or one project (projectId). body is markdown, sourceUrl an http(s) link to the ticket or thread. A customer can have several requests on one issue.

params.issueId: body string Issue id (exactly one of issueId / projectId)
params.projectId: body string Project id (exactly one of issueId / projectId)
params.body: body string Markdown: what the customer asked for
params.important: body boolean Flag the request as important (default false)
params.sourceUrl: body string http(s) URL of the source ticket, email thread or call notes

name: update_customer_request
description: Edit a customer request: markdown body, important flag, sourceUrl. null clears body and sourceUrl.

params.body: body string Markdown body, null clears
params.sourceUrl: body string http(s) source URL, null clears

name: find_customer_requests
description: Customer requests across customers, newest first, in full. Filter by customer, issue, project or importance to see what is asked on an issue or project.

params.issueId: query string Only requests on this issue
params.projectId: query string Only requests on this project
params.important: query string(true|false) Only important (true) or not (false)

name: unlink_customer_request
description: Delete a customer request. The issue or project is kept.

name: list_artifacts
description: PRs, docs, builds, deployments, links etc. attached to workstreams, issues and projects.

name: get_artifact
description: One artifact.

name: create_artifact
description: Attach an artifact (PR, build, document, link…) to a project, an issue and/or a workstream. At least one of projectId, issueId, workstreamId is required.

params.title: body string! Title
params.description: body string Why it is attached / what it is (markdown)

name: update_artifact
description: Update an artifact.

name: delete_artifact
description: Delete an artifact.

name: list_issue_artifacts
description: Artifacts attached to an issue.

params.idOrKey: path string! Issue id or key (e.g. BUG-142)

name: list_decisions
description: Architecture/product decisions (ADR-n).

name: get_decision
description: One decision.

params.idOrKey: path string! Decision id or key (e.g. ADR-21)

name: create_decision
description: Propose a decision (status proposed or draft; accepted/rejected need a person).

name: update_decision
description: Update a decision's content.

params.idOrKey: path string! Decision id or key (e.g. ADR-21)
params.title: body string Title

name: accept_decision
description: Accept a proposed decision (people only; may be refused for agent tokens).

params.idOrKey: path string! Decision id or key (e.g. ADR-21)

name: reject_decision
description: Reject a proposed decision.

params.idOrKey: path string! Decision id or key (e.g. ADR-21)

name: supersede_decision
description: Mark a decision superseded by another.

params.idOrKey: path string! Decision id or key (e.g. ADR-21)
params.byId: body string! Id or key of the replacement

name: delete_decision
description: Delete a decision.

params.idOrKey: path string! Decision id or key (e.g. ADR-21)

name: list_dependencies
description: Blocking relations between workstreams.

name: get_dependency
description: One dependency.

name: create_dependency
description: 'from' blocks 'to'. Cycles are rejected.

name: delete_dependency
description: Remove a dependency.

name: list_comments
description: Comments on an entity.

name: create_comment
description: Comment on an entity.

name: update_comment
description: Edit your own comment.

name: delete_comment
description: Delete a comment (author or admin).

name: list_views
description: Saved views (shared + yours).

name: get_view
description: One saved view.

name: create_view
description: Create a saved view.

params.name: body string! Name
params.filters: body object[] [{field, op, value}]. op: is|is_not|in|not_in|contains|before|after|gte|lte. Issue and project views also filter on customerId, customerTierId (ids) and, with gte/lte, customerCount, requestCount, importantCount, customerRevenue, customerSize
params.layout: body string(list|board|graph|timeline) Layout (timeline only for workstream and project views)
params.shared: body boolean Visible to everyone (legacy; same as sharing.visibility workspace|private)
params.sharing: body object {visibility: private|workspace|link, grants?: [{userId, level: view|edit}]} (link = anyone with the public link can read it)

name: update_view
description: Update a saved view (owner or admin for shared).

params.name: body string Name
params.filters: body object[] [{field, op, value}]. op: is|is_not|in|not_in|contains|before|after|gte|lte. Issue and project views also filter on customerId, customerTierId (ids) and, with gte/lte, customerCount, requestCount, importantCount, customerRevenue, customerSize
params.layout: body string(list|board|graph|timeline) Layout (timeline only for workstream and project views)
params.shared: body boolean Visible to everyone (legacy; same as sharing.visibility workspace|private)
params.sharing: body object {visibility: private|workspace|link, grants?: [{userId, level: view|edit}]} (link = anyone with the public link can read it)

name: delete_view
description: Delete a saved view.

name: get_insights
description: Where are the problems? Health signals (blocked, waiting for input and who the bottleneck is, stale, overdue, scope creep, PRs stuck in review, failing CI, undecided decisions, customer demand waiting), flow metrics (cycle/lead p50/p85, throughput, WIP, aging, cumulative flow) and agent failure signals. Each signal lists its items.

params.days: query integer Look-back window in days: 7, 30 or 90 (default 30)
params.teamId: query string Only this team's work
params.projectId: query string Only this project's work
params.staleDays: query integer Days without activity before work is stale (1-90, default 7)
params.limit: query integer Items kept per signal, 1-500 (default 25); counts always cover everything

name: get_insight_signal
description: The full item list behind one health signal (what a tile of get_insights drills into).

params.days: query integer Look-back window in days: 7, 30 or 90 (default 30)
params.teamId: query string Only this team's work
params.projectId: query string Only this project's work
params.staleDays: query integer Days without activity before work is stale (1-90, default 7)

name: list_attention
description: Things waiting for a human (input requested, decisions, failing CI, blocked, deadlines...). Needs a user token.

name: dismiss_attention
description: Dismiss an attention item.

params.id: path string! Attention item id, e.g. input_requested:ir_abc

name: snooze_attention
description: Snooze an attention item until a future time.

params.until: body string! ISO timestamp in the future

name: restore_attention
description: Restore a dismissed/snoozed item.
